name: Shading models
aliases: Diffuse and Specular Shading for Volume Rendering
definition: A shading technique implemented within the ray casting volume renderer that calculates diffuse and specular contributions based on data values and gradients.
summary: Shading models enhance 3D structure perception in volume rendering by applying simplified Phong-like diffuse and specular heuristics to data gradients, distinct from physically based transport or phase function methods.
